" alt="失败案例 OVON 2469，目标为picture，PDF p. 18。step46 fresh depth 1.20m通过，step47停止；benchmark goal distance 2.15m，因此失败。" width="1712" height="420" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div><figcaption><strong>Figure 11</strong> · 失败案例 OVON 2469，目标为picture，PDF p. 18。step46 fresh depth 1.20m通过，step47停止；benchmark goal distance 2.15m，因此失败。 <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#A3.F11">作者原图；中文图注为概括</a></figcaption></figure><h3>从结果直接可见，但作者未单独命名为 limitation 的现象</h3><div class="reader-table"><table><thead><tr><th>直接观察</th><th>原文定位</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>【直接观察】R2R Rand100 同 GPT-5.5 比较中，SR高于AgenticNav，SPL却低12.6个百分点（35.8 vs 48.4）；成功和效率不能合成一个全面最优结论。</td><td>Table 2，PDF p. 7</td></tr><tr><td>【直接观察】HM3D-v2 全量的 SPL 37.9低于DRIVE-Nav 41.3；OVON消融加Stop时SPL 34.2→33.0。</td><td>Tables 3–4，PDF pp. 7–8</td></tr><tr><td>【直接观察】在表6 GPT-5.6-luna 的OVON子集，OSR 74.0而SR 55.0，相差19.0个百分点；这是该子集的差值，不是未测环境泛化结论。</td><td>Table 6，PDF p. 14</td></tr><tr><td>【直接观察】图7成功的RxR案例用926步，超过默认500步预算；它仅说明扩展预算下这一案例的行为。</td><td>Fig. 7，PDF p. 17</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p><span class="tag">论文未明确说明</span>论文未明确说明真实任务的重复试验数、汇总成功率、端到端时延或每回合模型调用成本；本文不给这些量填入估计值。各实验表未报告多次运行的误差条或置信区间。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S5">Sec. 5；Tables 2–6，PDF pp. 7–9、13–14</a></p></section><section id="section-09" tabindex="-1"><h2>09 · Future Work / Research Implications</h2><p><span class="tag">作者表述</span>作者提出探索自演化机制，使编排与验证能够通过开放环境中的交互逐步完善。原文没有在此给出新的实验方案、具体模块或时间表。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S6">Sec. 6，最后一句，PDF p. 9</a></p></section><section id="section-10" tabindex="-1"><h2>10 · 论文逻辑链</h2><ol class="flow"><li><strong>现实问题</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>机器人需在部分可观测环境中按指令或物体目标到达目的地。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1，第1段</a></p></li><li><strong>现有方法</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>训练方法从导航数据学习，training-free方法借助预训练MLLM规划。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1，第2段</a></p></li><li><strong>为什么不够</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>提议校验、证据保留、失败处理缺少统一协调，计划可能偏离实际状态。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1，第3段</a></p></li><li><strong>关键观察</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>识别目标不等于到达，发出动作不等于完成子目标；这是一项问题判断，未配前置定量发现实验。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1，第4段</a></p></li><li><strong>核心思想</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>在运行时联合跟踪空间证据、任务进度和执行结果。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1，第4段</a></p></li><li><strong>具体方法</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>共享Harness组织事件记忆、ST Graph、统一工具、提议验证、反馈更新与停止验证。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S3">Sec. 3；Fig. 2</a></p></li><li><strong>实验验证</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>四个全量benchmark、固定子集累积消融和同模型比较、预算诊断及人形机器人案例共同组成证据。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S4">Secs. 4–5；Appendix 1、3</a></p></li><li><strong>结论</strong><p><span class="tag">概括</span>作者认为任务完成得到改善且具现实适用性，同时保留效率差异和预定义规则的限制。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S6">Sec. 4.3；Sec. 6</a></p></li></ol></section><section id="section-11" tabindex="-1"><h2>11 · 第一遍阅读结束后，我应该记住的东西</h2><ol><li><p><span class="tag">概括</span>问题：让MLLM提出的导航动作随空间证据、任务进度和执行结果的变化持续推进真实任务完成。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1</a></p></li><li><p><span class="tag">概括</span>Gap：作者认为现有流水线缺少联合协调证据保留、提议校验、失败处理的共享运行时，而非普遍缺少记忆或工具。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1；Sec. 2</a></p></li><li><p><span class="tag">概括</span>Insight：识别不是到达，发出动作不是完成；这是引言明确提出的动机判断，不是新增的前置实验发现。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S1">Sec. 1，第4段</a></p></li><li><p><span class="tag">概括</span>核心变化：将规划提议交由Harness验证，经统一工具执行，再以结构化反馈更新状态，停止也纳入同一闭环。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S3">Sec. 3；Fig. 2</a></p></li><li><p><span class="tag">概括</span>最重要结果：v3报告全量R2R/RxR/HM3D-v2/OVON的SR为59.6/51.4/76.0/59.3%；累积消融支持任务完成改善，但路径效率并非全面最优。</p><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#S4">Tables 2–4；Sec. 4.3–4.4</a></p></li></ol></section><section id="section-12" tabindex="-1"><h2>12 · 暂时不要深入的内容</h2><ul><li>状态、图、检索评分的变量和参数含义：Sec. 3.1.1、3.2，Eqs. (1)–(3)，PDF pp. 3、5</li><li>完整运行时伪代码的步骤先后与更新时机：Algorithm 1，PDF p. 6</li><li>停止三条件与fresh-depth / projected-target回退、阈值及测地距离判据：Eq. (4)、Appendix 1.3、Table 5，PDF pp. 6、13</li><li>角色prompt、稳定TODO标识、证据ID、归一化框坐标与执行契约：Appendix 2.1–2.2，PDF p. 15</li><li>图5 dashboard中几何地图、图计数与评估器字段的区别，以及图6–11事件步号与RGB帧号的对应：Appendix 3，PDF pp. 16–18</li></ul><p class="source">原文定位 · <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2609.15195v3#A2">Appendix 2；其余定位见各条</a></p></section></article></div></div></main><footer class="reader-license-note">阅读范围截至 Stage 1。正文为中文整理，作者声明、概括和图表直接观察分别标注。原图与论文内容来自 Yang Chen 等，arXiv:2609.15195v3（CC BY 4.0）；中文图注为概括，Figure 4为PDF页面裁剪，其余嵌图为作者原图。正文、图片与公式均内嵌，可离线阅读；原文与项目页链接需联网。<h3>作者、来源与公开使用说明</h3><p>HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness。作者：Yang Chen、Lirong Che、Zhenyu Huang、Wenbo Fu、Chuang Wang、Xu Cao、Daqi Liu、Yuzhe Yang、Jian Su、Lan-Zhe Guo。来源：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15195v3">arXiv:2609.15195v3</a>，采用<a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International（CC BY 4.0）</a>。Figure 4为PDF页面裁剪，其余为原文图像抽取；页面按显示宽度缩放，中文图注与分析为整理者转述。本页不是作者官方报告，不暗示作者认可或背书；不重新分发完整PDF。第三方单独标注材料仍以其原有权利说明为准。</p></footer><p class="reader-footer">阅读报告 v1 · 集成预览 · 待视觉验收 · 受控预览，尚未正式收录 · 原文及项目链接需联网</p><div class="reader-toast" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></div><script>/* Reader controls only: no models, analytics, remote scripts or automatic PDF fetch. */
(() => {
 'use strict';
 const page=document.querySelector('.reader-page');if(!page)return;
 const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'),toc=page.querySelector('.reader-toc'),tocButton=page.querySelector('.reader-toc-toggle');
 const compact=matchMedia('(max-width:767px)'),position=page.querySelector('.reader-position'),previousSection=page.querySelector('[data-reader-previous]'),nextSection=page.querySelector('[data-reader-next]'),sectionLabel=page.querySelector('[data-reader-section-label]');let currentSection=0,programmaticTarget=null;
 const sections=[...page.querySelectorAll('.reader-article>section[id]')],tocLinks=[...toc.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]')];
 let frame=0,toastTimer=0,toast=document.querySelector('.reader-toast');
 const siteHeader=document.querySelector('.atlas-site-header'),stagebar=page.querySelector('.reader-stagebar');
 function syncChrome(){
  if(!siteHeader||!stagebar)return;
  const headerHeight=siteHeader.getBoundingClientRect().height,barHeight=stagebar.getBoundingClientRect().height;
  if(!(headerHeight>0&&barHeight>0))return;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--atlas-header-height',headerHeight+'px');
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--reader-chrome-bottom',(headerHeight+barHeight)+'px');
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--reader-anchor-offset',(headerHeight+barHeight+16)+'px');
 }
 syncChrome();
 function announce(message){clearTimeout(toastTimer);toast.textContent=message;toast.hidden=false;toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{toast.hidden=true;},2400);}
 function selectSection(index){
  currentSection=Math.max(0,Math.min(sections.length-1,index));
  tocLinks.forEach(link=>{const active=link.hash==='#'+sections[currentSection]?.id;link.classList.toggle('is-current',active);if(active)link.setAttribute('aria-current','location');else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');});
  if(position)position.textContent=String(currentSection+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+String(sections.length).padStart(2,'0');
  if(previousSection)previousSection.disabled=currentSection===0;if(nextSection)nextSection.disabled=currentSection===sections.length-1;
  if(sectionLabel)sectionLabel.textContent=tocLinks[currentSection]?.textContent||'';
 }
 function updatePosition(){
  frame=0;const offset=Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).scrollPaddingTop)||144;
  const effectiveTop=section=>section.getBoundingClientRect().top-(Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(section).scrollMarginTop)||0);
  const atBottom=Number.isFinite(window.scrollY)&&window.scrollY>0&&window.innerHeight+window.scrollY>=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-2;
  if(programmaticTarget!==null){
   const targetTop=effectiveTop(sections[programmaticTarget]);
   if(Math.abs(targetTop-offset)<=6||(atBottom&&targetTop>=offset-6))programmaticTarget=null;
   else{selectSection(programmaticTarget);return;}
  }
  let current=sections[0];for(const section of sections){if(effectiveTop(section)<=offset+6)current=section;else break;}
  if(atBottom)current=sections[sections.length-1];selectSection(Math.max(0,sections.indexOf(current)));
 }

 const schedule=()=>{if(!frame&&!document.hidden)frame=requestAnimationFrame(updatePosition);};
 window.addEventListener('scroll',schedule,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{syncChrome();schedule();});window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{programmaticTarget=null;schedule();});window.addEventListener('pageshow',()=>{syncChrome();schedule();});
 if(typeof ResizeObserver==='function'&&siteHeader&&stagebar){const chromeObserver=new ResizeObserver(()=>{syncChrome();schedule();});chromeObserver.observe(siteHeader);chromeObserver.observe(stagebar);}
 const interruptScroll=()=>{programmaticTarget=null;schedule();};
 const isSectionControl=target=>[previousSection,nextSection,tocButton,...tocLinks].some(control=>control&&(control===target||control.contains(target)));
 const pointerIntent=e=>{if(!isSectionControl(e.target))interruptScroll();};
 window.addEventListener('wheel',interruptScroll,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('touchstart',pointerIntent,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('touchmove',interruptScroll,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('pointerdown',pointerIntent,{passive:true});
 window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','PageUp','PageDown','Home','End'].includes(e.key)||(e.key===' '&&!isSectionControl(e.target)))interruptScroll();});
 // A prior animation can emit scrollend after a newer navigation has started.
 // Only geometry (above) or genuine manual intent may settle that new target.
 window.addEventListener('scrollend',schedule);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);frame=0;programmaticTarget=null;}else schedule();});
 function closeToc(restore=false){toc.classList.remove('is-open');toc.inert=compact.matches;tocButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(restore)tocButton.focus({preventScroll:true});}
 tocButton.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=!toc.classList.contains('is-open');toc.classList.toggle('is-open',open);toc.inert=compact.matches&&!open;tocButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));if(open){const target=toc.querySelector('.is-current')||tocLinks[0];target?.focus({preventScroll:true});if(target)toc.scrollTop=Math.max(0,target.offsetTop-toc.clientHeight/2);}});
 tocLinks.forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.defaultPrevented||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.shiftKey||e.altKey||e.button>0)return;const index=sections.findIndex(section=>'#'+section.id===link.hash);if(index<0)return;e.preventDefault();closeToc();history.pushState(null,'',link.hash);goSection(index);}));
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&toc.classList.contains('is-open')&&!document.querySelector('dialog[open]')){e.preventDefault();closeToc(true);}});
 document.addEventListener('focusin',e=>{if(toc.classList.contains('is-open')&&e.target!==tocButton&&!toc.contains(e.target))closeToc();});
 compact.addEventListener?.('change',()=>{closeToc(compact.matches&&toc.contains(document.activeElement));schedule();});toc.inert=compact.matches;
 function goSection(index){const target=sections[index];if(!target)return;
  // Focus can interrupt an in-flight browser scroll even with preventScroll.
  // Finish focus changes first, then make this navigation the last scroll request.
  target.focus({preventScroll:true});programmaticTarget=index;selectSection(index);target.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:reduced.matches?'auto':'smooth'});
 }
 previousSection?.addEventListener('click',()=>goSection(currentSection-1));nextSection?.addEventListener('click',()=>goSection(currentSection+1));
 const copies=new WeakMap();
 page.querySelectorAll('[data-copy-code]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
  const holder=button.closest('.code-reader'),lines=[...holder.querySelectorAll('.code-text')].map(line=>line.textContent),token=(copies.get(button)||0)+1;copies.set(button,token);
  try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(lines.join('\n'));if(copies.get(button)===token&&button.isConnected)announce('代码片段已复制，未包含行号');}
  catch{if(copies.get(button)===token&&button.isConnected)announce('未能访问剪贴板，可在代码框中手动选择复制');}
 }));
 page.querySelectorAll('[data-code-focus]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const holder=button.closest('.code-reader'),active=!holder.classList.contains('is-focused');holder.classList.toggle('is-focused',active);button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(active));
  const pre=holder.querySelector('pre'),first=holder.querySelector('.code-line.is-key');
  if(active&&first)pre.scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,first.offsetTop-pre.clientHeight/3),behavior:reduced.matches?'auto':'smooth'});
 }));
 const sourceData=page.querySelector('[data-source-units]');
 if(sourceData){
  let units=[];try{units=JSON.parse(sourceData.textContent);}catch{};
  const panel=page.querySelector('.reader-source-panel'),rows=page.querySelectorAll('[data-source-row]'),buttons=page.querySelectorAll('[data-source-unit]');let selected=0;
  const show=(id,scroll=false)=>{const index=units.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);if(index<0)return;selected=index;const unit=units[index];
   panel.querySelector('[data-source-id]').textContent=unit.id;panel.querySelector('[data-source-location]').textContent=unit.location;panel.querySelector('[data-source-paraphrase]').textContent=unit.paraphrase;
   const quote=panel.querySelector('[data-source-quote]');quote.hidden=!unit.quote;quote.textContent=unit.quote||'';
   const a=panel.querySelector('[data-source-open]');a.href=unit.url;a.textContent=(unit.link_label||'打开原文位置')+' ↗';
   panel.querySelector('[data-source-previous]').disabled=index===0;panel.querySelector('[data-source-next]').disabled=index===units.length-1;
   rows.forEach(row=>(row.closest('.source-row')||row).classList.toggle('is-current',row.dataset.sourceRow===id));buttons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.sourceUnit===id)));
   if(scroll){interruptScroll();page.querySelector('[data-source-row="'+CSS.escape(id)+'"]')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:reduced.matches?'auto':'smooth'});}
  };
  buttons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{show(b.dataset.sourceUnit);if(innerWidth<=1050){const unit=units.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.sourceUnit);announce(unit?.location||'已选择原文位置');}}));
  panel.querySelector('[data-source-previous]').addEventListener('click',()=>show(units[Math.max(0,selected-1)].id,true));panel.querySelector('[data-source-next]').addEventListener('click',()=>show(units[Math.min(units.length-1,selected+1)].id,true));
  const toggle=page.querySelector('[data-source-toggle]');toggle?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const off=page.classList.toggle('reader-source-collapsed');toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!off));});if(units.length)show(units[0].id);
 }
 updatePosition();
})();
</script></body></html>
